articles.title: Seattle food festival shooting leaves 3 dead; police seek second suspect
bullets: Gunfire broke out Sunday evening at the Bite of Seattle near the Space Needle.
Authorities said three people were killed and four others were injured, including a toddler.
Police arrested one suspect and said they were searching for another involved in the exchange of gunfire.

articles.title: Appeals court keeps block on Trump order to create federal voter list
bullets: A U.S. appeals court upheld an injunction blocking the executive order.
The order sought to create a federal voter list tied to mail-voting rules.
The ruling keeps the challenged election changes on hold while litigation continues.

articles.title: Pentagon casualty count no longer lists 4 troops killed in renewed Iran fighting
bullets: Four U.S. troops killed during renewed U.S.-Iran fighting were moved out of the official Iran war death toll.
The deaths were placed in a separate Pentagon category.
The change raised questions about how the administration counts the conflict’s impact on U.S. service members.

articles.title: Heat dome expands across central U.S., bringing dangerous conditions
bullets: Extreme heat warnings covered parts of the central United States.
Forecasters warned that limited overnight cooling would increase health risks.
Officials urged residents to limit outdoor activity and check on vulnerable people.

articles.title: Cyclospora outbreak linked to Taco Bell cases expands to four more states
bullets: Health officials reported additional Cyclospora cases tied to a multistate outbreak.
The investigation includes cases linked to Taco Bell and contaminated produce concerns.
Cyclospora infections can cause prolonged diarrhea and other gastrointestinal symptoms.

articles.title: Mediators report progress toward renewed U.S.-Iran talks after pause in attacks
bullets: Regional officials said Qatar and Pakistan were helping bridge gaps between Washington and Tehran.
Neither the U.S. nor Iran reported new attacks for three straight days.
The pause followed nearly two weeks of escalating strikes tied to the Strait of Hormuz conflict.

articles.title: Questions mount after deadly Berlin Pride attack suspect is killed by police
bullets: German authorities said the 21-year-old suspect was killed after a nearly 24-hour search.
The attack near Berlin’s Pride festival left one woman dead and 29 people injured.
Officials are reviewing how the suspect remained free after earlier Islamic State-linked proceedings.

articles.title: France and Spain battle historic wildfires after mass evacuations
bullets: Heat waves and dry conditions fueled major fires across France and Spain.
AP reported more than 300,000 people displaced across the two countries.
France said a giant Gironde-region blaze had stopped growing but remained dangerous.

articles.title: Tadej Pogacar wins record-equaling fifth Tour de France title
bullets: Pogacar confirmed his place among cycling’s all-time greats with another Tour victory.
The win tied him with the five-time champions in Tour de France history.
The final stage concluded in Paris on Sunday.

articles.title: Indonesia garbage-mountain community sees changes as methane cuts begin
bullets: An AP climate story examined life near a large Indonesian waste site.
Indonesia is working to reduce methane emissions from waste and other sources.
The effort is part of broader climate action targeting a powerful greenhouse gas.

articles.title: Nitin Gadkari moves Bombay High Court over E20 deepfake and defamation claims
bullets: Gadkari reportedly sought to sue Meta, X, Google and others over social media content.
The posts allegedly linked him and his family to profits from India’s E20 ethanol-blended petrol policy.
He argued the policy is run by the Petroleum Ministry, not his ministry.

articles.title: Sonam Wangchuk discharged from hospital, says he will return to the mountains
bullets: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk was discharged from hospital, according to HT’s India news feed.
He said he planned to return to the mountains after treatment.
The update followed recent reporting around youth protests and hunger-strike activity.

articles.title: BTech student dies after jumping from IIT Guwahati hostel building, police say
bullets: Police said a BTech student died after jumping from a hostel building at IIT Guwahati.
The report appeared among Hindustan Times’ top India updates on Monday.
Authorities were investigating the circumstances of the death.

articles.title: Supreme Court waits for Nilekani task force views on online NEET
bullets: The Supreme Court said it would review recommendations from a Nandan Nilekani-led task force.
The case concerns online conduct of NEET after allegations around a paper leak and re-test.
The bench noted the need for safeguards on cybersecurity and database protection.

articles.title: Lok Sabha adjourned amid opposition protest over pellet-gun use
bullets: Parliament’s monsoon session saw opposition protests over police action against demonstrators.
The Lok Sabha was adjourned till noon amid the disruptions.
The session also included debate around an anti-paper-leak bill.

articles.title: Wall Street set to open higher as U.S.-Iran pause lifts sentiment
bullets: U.S. stock index futures rose Monday after a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities.
Investors also looked ahead to major earnings, economic data and a Federal Reserve decision.
The easing of geopolitical pressure helped risk appetite before the opening bell.

articles.title: Oil retreats from recent highs after U.S. and Iran pause attacks
bullets: Brent crude for September delivery fell 4.9% to $92.02 in early trading.
Benchmark U.S. oil for September delivery fell 5.6% to $84.34.
Lower oil prices reduced immediate inflation pressure tied to the Middle East conflict.

articles.title: Big Tech earnings week puts Microsoft, Meta and Amazon in focus
bullets: Reuters’ week-ahead coverage flagged Microsoft, Meta and Amazon earnings as key market events.
Investors are watching AI spending and cloud growth after Alphabet disappointed some traders.
Tech earnings are expected to influence the Nasdaq and broader S&P 500 direction.

articles.title: Markets watch Fed decision as oil and inflation concerns linger
bullets: Traders are preparing for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision this week.
AP reported oil’s July surge had renewed concerns about inflation pressure.
Higher rates could weigh on housing, borrowing and AI data-center financing.

articles.title: CNBC highlights rotation as small caps rally and megacap tech cools
bullets: CNBC’s market page flagged a small-cap rally alongside weakness in Magnificent 7 names.
The rotation came during a week dominated by earnings and Fed expectations.
Midday mover coverage also included Paramount Skydance, Cava, Capri and SailPoint.

articles.title: Trump tariff policy framed as forced-labor crackdown draws scrutiny
bullets: AP examined the administration’s use of forced-labor arguments to support tariffs.
Critics questioned whether the approach bypasses Congress on trade policy.
The story focused on the legal and business impact of new tariff actions.

articles.title: Energy markets ease, but U.S. gasoline remains elevated
bullets: Oil prices fell after the pause in U.S.-Iran attacks.
AP reported the U.S. average regular gasoline price at $4.11 per gallon on Sunday.
Fuel costs remained higher than a month earlier and much higher than a year earlier.

articles.title: Cava shares slide after quarterly revenue miss and guidance cut
bullets: CNBC-linked market-mover coverage said Cava fell after missing Q2 revenue expectations.
The company also missed same-store sales expectations and lowered its forecast.
The move made the restaurant chain one of the day’s notable consumer-stock movers.

articles.title: Paramount Skydance surges in heavy trading amid meme-stock attention
bullets: Market-mover coverage said Paramount Skydance jumped sharply intraday.
The rally drew attention because of unusually heavy volume and meme-stock comparisons.
The move came as media-sector investors tracked consolidation and streaming strategy.

articles.title: Hanesbrands rises after $4.4 billion takeover agreement with Gildan
bullets: Market-mover coverage said Hanesbrands gained after agreeing to a takeover deal.
The buyer is Canada’s Gildan Activewear, with the transaction valued at about $4.4 billion.
The deal added to a busy week of retail and consumer-company stock moves.

articles.title: Big Tech backs open-weight AI models in Washington policy debate
bullets: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir and others signed a letter supporting open-weight AI.
The companies warned against premature restrictions on open AI systems.
The push comes as policymakers weigh safety, China competition and cyber risks.

articles.title: Instagram and YouTube found liable in landmark social media addiction trial
bullets: A California jury found Meta and YouTube liable in a first-of-its-kind case.
The jury awarded damages to a 20-year-old plaintiff who said platform design harmed her as a child.
The verdict could influence thousands of similar lawsuits against social media companies.

articles.title: Parents seek platform changes after verdicts against social media companies
bullets: Parents involved in social media harm cases welcomed the jury rulings against Meta and YouTube.
Advocates said the decisions could increase pressure for design changes and warnings.
The companies have disputed claims that their platforms alone caused youth mental-health harms.

articles.title: Apple opens new Siri AI to users through iOS 27 public beta
bullets: TechCrunch’s July coverage highlighted Apple’s new Siri AI becoming available in the iOS 27 public beta.
The release gives more users access to Apple’s latest assistant upgrades.
It marks another step in Apple’s broader AI rollout across consumer devices.

articles.title: OpenAI researcher in talks to launch AI drug-discovery startup valued at $2B
bullets: TechCrunch reported that OpenAI researcher Miles Wang was in talks to start an AI drug-discovery company.
The potential startup was described as seeking a valuation around $2 billion.
The talks reflect continued investor interest in AI applications for biotech and medicine.
